text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Day after day was spent putting on the 
finishing touches for the grand stage.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Power and stamina are both crucial for the 
Takarazuka Kinen. On top of that, you need 
to decide when to make your move—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"And here is the overview of the race 
developments over the past 10 years... 
Given the time of year, rain seems likely 
too. All right, I'll memorize all of 
this!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant, pant*! ...*cough*! *cough, 
cough*!"
choice_data_list: How about we take a break?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
N-No! I'm just a little out of breath...! 
I'm fine, I can still keep going!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hoo, hoo, hah, phew! Not done yet, the 
real run starts now...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely... going to take center 
stage...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I'm goiiiiiing!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Give the utmost effort possible right now, 
pushing to the absolute limit every single 
day without compromise—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, the computational results of 
'Parcae' did not change."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "The winner: Dantsu Flame"—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaaaaahhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ............ Time to run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the day of the Takarazuka Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I really like how hard Dantsu Flame tries! 
Taking on the challenge right after the 
Yasuda Kinen is so cool too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I watched the footage of the Kikuka-sho, 
and seriously, she was trying so super 
hard!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"Have you seen her Umastagram? She posts 
on it diligently every single day."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
She's always so bright— the word 
'dedicated' fits her to a tee—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The grand prix that caps off the first 
half of the year! The excitement is 
reaching a fever pitch...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It seems this year's star is indeed Dantsu 
Flame!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ngggh!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, um!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Being called "this year's main star" made 
me so happy...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
We haven't even started yet, though. But 
I'm still just so happy, because—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: To think I've finally made it this far...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I dreamed of being the star, and then I 
met Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Learning how to pour all my feelings into 
it. Training so hard, day in and day out.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I missed out on being the star so many 
times, but I just couldn't give up—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Because I chose my own path, I was able 
to come... this far."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I...! I will definitely become 
the star of the show today!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
So that I will never, ever let anyone 
down—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'll deliver a race worthy of the "lead 
role"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Those eyes were burning with fire.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since the day we met, I've kept 
aiming to be the 'lead role.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A dream like that can surely be fulfilled 
now!
choice_data_list: Today, let's give it everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The curtain rises on the Takarazuka Kinen!
